Chains.description: An array of coin chain definitions.

coinEntry.description: Defines a single coin item within a chain.

Coin.description: The item ID of the coin. REQUIRED.

exchangeRate.description: How many of the previous coin are needed for this coin. REQUIRED except for the first entry in CoreChain.

ParentCoin.description: The item ID of the parent coin from the CoreChain. ONLY for the first entry of a SideChain.

initial.description: A 1-2 character initial for the coin (for 'coin' displayType).

plural.description: Plural name of the coin (for 'coin' displayType).

baseUnit.description: Marks this coin as the base unit for value display (for 'number' displayType). Should only be true for one coin in a chain.

chainEntry.description: Defines a full coin chain, including its display properties and coins.

chain.description: A unique ID for this coin chain. At least one must be 'main'. REQUIRED.

name.description: The display name of the chain. REQUIRED.

displayType.description: The display type for this chain's values. REQUIRED.

InputType.description: The input type for this coin chain. REQUIRED.

EventChain.description: If true, this chain is locked behind a server event. OPTIONAL.

CoreChain.description: The main list of coins in this chain. MANDATORY.

SideChains.description: Additional coin chains that branch off from the CoreChain. OPTIONAL.

ATMData.description: Configuration for ATM exchange buttons for this chain. OPTIONAL.

displayFormat.description: The format for displaying numerical values. REQUIRED for 'number' displayType.

displayFormatWordy.description: An optional, more descriptive format for the Value Input widget. OPTIONAL.
